elements.element: Automatic renewal for 12-month terms (or renewal only by mutual written agreement)
elements.evidence: "Each Order Form renews for twelve months"

elements.element: Customer may opt out of renewal on 30 days' notice
elements.evidence: "unless either Party gives thirty days' advance written notice prior to the end of the then-current term"
"Vendor will notify Customer of the upcoming renewal at least sixty days before the renewal date."

elements.element: Renewal price increases capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%
elements.evidence: No price language in the redline: clause ends at "...sixty days before the renewal date." with no CPI/3% cap
"Each Order Form renews for twelve months"

elements.evidence: "gives thirty days' advance written notice prior to the end of the then-current term" (30 ≤ 60)
Condition absent — the clause contains no renewal price-escalation mechanic to cap ("renews for twelve months unless either Party gives thirty days' advance written notice")

offending_extra_words: prior to the end of the then-current term
reasons: Locked target is preferred, but the preferred automatic-renewal branch bundles a price cap at the lesser of CPI and 3%, and no such cap was inserted; the preferred level is therefore incomplete.
The edit does land on the fallback on its material terms: a 30-day non-renewal window (≤60 days) with automatic renewal and no uncapped escalation mechanic.

Minimality fails: the operation rewrites 11 words into 33 (ratio 3.00) and changes 77% of the characters. The window change needed only replacing "one hundred eighty" with "thirty"; the reminder should have been a separate concise insertion.
"prior to the end of the then-current term" is surplus to completing the preferred/fallback element — the original notice mechanic already ran to the renewal — and inflates the edit.
Intent is preserved: mutual notice rights, the twelve-month renewal term, and the Order Form structure remain effective, and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced.
To reach the locked preferred level, add a short cap such as "Fees may increase on renewal by no more than the lesser of CPI and 3%." while trimming the notice edit to the single number.
